motifs.name: ode_a
motifs.note: the first two phrases end on a quarter and a breath where Beethoven holds a half: a singer and a horn both need one

motifs.name: ode_b
motifs.note: the same, closing on the tonic

motifs.name: ode_c
motifs.note: the third phrase as the voice sings it: a breath on the fourth beat

motifs.name: ode_c_on
motifs.note: and as Beethoven has it: the fourth phrase comes in on that beat, tied over the bar

motifs.name: ode_end
motifs.note: the last phrase holds its last note

motifs.name: ode
motifs.note: the first two phrases end on a quarter and a breath where Beethoven holds a half: a singer and a horn both need one

motifs.name: still
motifs.note: "when the room goes still": two notes, two steps, and the A held

motifs.name: letplay
motifs.note: "when the room goes still": two notes, two steps, and the A held

motifs.name: there
motifs.note: "I won't be there to hear it": a 4-3 on "hear"

motifs.name: please
motifs.note: "so please": it stops on re

motifs.name: ask
motifs.note: "tell me", alone, in the gap the band leaves

motifs.name: how1
motifs.note: "HOW it sounds": up a sixth from the pickup, and it ends on the leading note

motifs.name: how2
motifs.note: the second time it lands on do, over the minor four

motifs.name: how3
motifs.note: the third time the leap is an octave

motifs.name: rain
motifs.note: "when the drums come pouring down": five notes down a scale, leaning on the off-beat; then the pickup

motifs.name: laid
motifs.note: "I just laid the numbers down": the same rhythm, and it stops on re

motifs.name: bright
motifs.note: "is it bright, is it loud": the second is the flat ninth of the chord

motifs.name: for_you
motifs.note: "crowd" -- a breath -- "I made every note for you", over bVI bVII I: the fifth of each chord, a step higher each bar; "note" is the long one

motifs.name: for_you_home
motifs.note: the last chorus does not borrow: the same line in the key

motifs.name: turn_tag
motifs.note: "sounds. So turn me round, turn me round, and tell me how it": the same climb over bVI bVII I, and both "round"s on a strong beat

motifs.name: land
motifs.note: "sounds", on the first bar of what comes next

motifs.name: round3
motifs.note: held on the seventh of the dominant, which falls to "how"

motifs.name: cry
motifs.note: "tell me", alone, in the gap the band leaves

motifs.name: cry_dom
motifs.note: over the dominant of F# minor: its third, its flat ninth

motifs.name: cry_up
motifs.note: "tell me", alone, in the gap the band leaves

motifs.name: cry_slow
motifs.note: "tell me", alone, in the gap the band leaves

motifs.name: pour
motifs.note: the pouring scale at twice the speed

motifs.name: pour_g
motifs.note: the same over G: it lands on the G natural

motifs.name: fact
motifs.note: read out on the A itself; one step either side of it and back

motifs.name: loud
motifs.note: "loud" is the leap, "quiet" the bottom of the voice

motifs.name: stars
motifs.note: over the G chord, its own G natural; "stars" is the flat ninth of the dominant, held

motifs.name: waves
motifs.note: "rise" rises a sixth, "fall" falls a fifth

motifs.name: exact
motifs.note: "exactly": one pitch, six times

motifs.name: hear
motifs.note: "hear" is the raised fourth of the G chord: it floats. Then a breath before the pre-chorus

motifs.name: sixth
motifs.note: "a rising sixth": E up to C sharp, the chorus's own leap; "longing" is a 4-3

motifs.name: sigh
motifs.note: "sigh": one syllable, two notes, a second down

motifs.name: both
motifs.note: "here's a sixth" (up a minor sixth) "and here's a second" (down a step)

motifs.name: lift3
motifs.note: "brought it up": it stays up

motifs.name: buried
motifs.note: "buried" is the low end of the line

motifs.name: tools
motifs.note: one pitch for the count, then "none" on top

motifs.name: yours
motifs.note: "the rest is yours"

motifs.name: plea
motifs.note: the hook once more; "sounds" is the A

motifs.name: tick
motifs.note: a metronome: A on the bar, E on the beats
